transcription.contentOrigin: packages/twin-github/src/tools.ts declares one zod schema per tool and no names; each inputSchema here is z.toJSONSchema() of that schema, frozen verbatim including the $schema key it emits. Descriptions are this twin's own.
transcription.comparedToUpstream: never, in the sense this field means: nothing has driven api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ and compared answers. The tool NAMES were compared, once, as two committed documents — pome-cloud's MCP lane (F-1327) against F-1326's upstream golden (fixtures/mcp-tools-list/github.canonical.json, 44 tools for the `default` toolset examples/support-triage points at) — and F-1376 acted on the result. Behaviour, argument schemas and descriptions remain uncompared.

notes: 36 tools since F-1376, down from 65. Thirty-four names GitHub declares under no toolset and no feature flag were dropped, and five GitHub does declare were added: issue_read, issue_write, pull_request_read, pull_request_review_write, list_repository_collaborators.

Two of the 36 are served that GitHub does not declare in the captured `default` surface: create_issue and create_pull_request_review. Both are real GitHub tools, registered into Default:true toolsets behind the client-settable X-MCP-Features flags issues_granular and pull_requests_granular, and both carry a registered entry in pome-cloud's known-divergences/github.mcp.yaml. The reasoning per tool is docs/github-mcp-twin-only-tools.md.

Dropping a tool from this listing does NOT drop the twin's REST route for the same operation. Fourteen of the thirty-four (milestones, commit statuses, check runs, issue-comment edit/delete) were GitHub REST operations that were never MCP tools upstream, and they remain reachable exactly the way an examinee could always have reached them at GitHub: over HTTP.
